name: engine_v2 blind GFS benchmark
training_basis: annual fixed 1-7-day lead offsets, with exact earlier weekly-run cases preferred for matching station/target/day band; final activation choices selected only on earlier October exact-run validation
window_probability_policy: Do not infer 6/12/24-hour probabilities from hourly marginal probabilities; leave unavailable in this baseline
threshold_note: Eligibility guards are declared prototype choices, not empirically established sufficiency thresholds. Constants 72 and 30 from the old engine are not used.
sensor_stream: BME280 t/h, checked rf/rfc rain; HDC and SHT fields not substituted
x66_reference_policy: User confirmed retaining t/h and flagging disagreement with tsht/hsht. October medians: t=12.02 C, tsht=18.885 C, h=100%, hsht=90%. No sensor substitution or ground-truth accuracy claim.

sensor_error_mapping.E3: HDC1080 thdc/hhdc, false flag if fields absent
sensor_error_mapping.E12: leaf wetness; false flag on devices without sensor

new_data_policy: Post-cutoff measurements may update scores only. Never refit or overwrite locked models or predictions. A later model must use a different version and benchmark.
